posts.title: What is Claude?

slides.title: THE AI EVERYONE IS QUIETLY SWITCHING TO

slides.heading: Meet Claude
slides.body: Claude is an AI assistant made by Anthropic. You talk to it in normal language and it writes, plans, codes, explains and designs with you.

slides.heading: It reads like a person
slides.body: Long documents, contracts, PDFs, even screenshots. Paste it in and ask questions like you would ask a colleague who actually read the whole thing.

slides.heading: It builds, not just chats
slides.body: Claude can write real code, build web pages and create documents you can use immediately. This whole brand you are looking at was built with it.

slides.heading: It is honest about limits
slides.body: Claude is trained to say when it is not sure instead of confidently making things up. That matters more than people realise.

slides.heading: It is free to try
slides.body: Go to claude.ai, sign up, and start with one real task from your day. Not a test question. A real one.

slides.text: AI will not replace you. A person using it well might.

posts.title: 5 prompts that make AI actually useful

slides.title: STOP TALKING TO AI LIKE IT IS GOOGLE

slides.heading: Give it a job
slides.body: Weak: tell me about marketing. Strong:
slides.example: You are a marketing coach for a one person design studio in South Africa. Give me a simple plan to get my first 5 clients.

slides.heading: Give it your context
slides.body: AI cannot read your mind. Paste your situation first, then ask.
slides.example: Here is my service list and prices. A client says I am too expensive. Write a reply that keeps the deal alive without dropping my price.

slides.heading: Ask for a format
slides.body: Tell it exactly what shape you want back.
slides.example: Give me a 7 day content plan as a table with columns for day, post idea and caption hook.

slides.heading: Make it ask you questions
slides.body: Flip the interview.
slides.example: Before you answer, ask me 5 questions that would make your answer better.

slides.heading: Ask for the critique
slides.body: The most underused prompt in the world.
slides.example: Here is my work. Be a harsh but fair critic. What is weak, and how do I fix it?

slides.heading: SAVE THESE 5
slides.body: Try one today on a real task. Follow for tomorrow: AI words explained like you are five.

posts.caption:

posts.title: AI words explained like you are 5

slides.title: AI WORDS, EXPLAINED LIKE YOU ARE FIVE

slides.heading: LLM
slides.body: Large Language Model. A program that read almost the whole internet and learned to predict what words come next. That is the engine inside Claude and ChatGPT.

slides.heading: Prompt
slides.body: Whatever you type to the AI. A lazy prompt gets a lazy answer. A clear brief gets clear work. Same as with people.

slides.heading: Token
slides.body: AI reads text in small chunks called tokens. Roughly three quarters of a word each. It is how the machine counts, and how usage gets measured.

slides.heading: Context window
slides.body: The AI's short term memory. Everything in your current chat lives here. When it fills up, old details fall out. That is why long chats drift.

slides.heading: Hallucination
slides.body: When AI states something false with full confidence. It is not lying, it is guessing. Always check names, numbers and quotes.

slides.heading: Agent
slides.body: AI that does not just answer but takes steps. It can browse, write files, run tools and finish a task while you do something else.

slides.heading: SHARE THIS WITH ONE PERSON
slides.body: Someone in your circle keeps nodding along to these words without knowing them. Send it. Follow for tomorrow: Claude vs ChatGPT, the honest version.

posts.caption:

posts.title: Claude vs ChatGPT, 6 honest differences

slides.title: CLAUDE VS CHATGPT. THE HONEST VERSION

slides.heading: Writing feel
slides.body: Claude tends to write warmer and more natural. ChatGPT can sound like a very confident press release. For client facing words, I reach for Claude.

slides.heading: Long documents
slides.body: Claude handles very long documents in one go and stays accurate deep into them. Contracts, research, briefs. This is its home ground.

slides.heading: Building things
slides.body: Claude creates artifacts, real working pages and documents you can see and edit live. It also powers Claude Code, which builds entire projects.

slides.heading: Saying I do not know
slides.body: Claude is more willing to admit uncertainty. Fewer confident wrong answers, which saves you from embarrassing mistakes.

slides.heading: Where ChatGPT wins
slides.body: Image generation, voice mode and a bigger plugin ecosystem. If you need pictures made from text, that is not Claude's game today.

slides.heading: The real answer
slides.body: The best AI is the one you learn deeply. Pick one, use it daily for a month, and it will change how you work. I picked Claude.

slides.body: Follow for tomorrow: how I built my entire brand with AI in one day. Real receipts.

posts.title: The 3 part prompt formula

slides.title: THE 3 PART PROMPT FORMULA I USE EVERY DAY

slides.heading: Part 1: Role
slides.body: Tell the AI who to be. This sets the quality bar and the vocabulary.
slides.example: You are a senior copywriter who writes for small African businesses.

slides.heading: Part 2: Task and context
slides.body: What you need, plus the situation. Paste real details, do not summarise.
slides.example: Write my Instagram bio. I am a graphic designer, I do branding and social media, clients book me on WhatsApp.

slides.heading: Part 3: Format and rules
slides.body: The shape of the answer, and your taste.
slides.example: Give me 5 options, each under 150 characters. Plain human language. No dashes, no buzzwords.

slides.heading: All together
slides.body: Role plus task plus format. Three sentences minimum, that is the whole trick.
slides.example: You are a senior copywriter. Write my designer bio, clients book on WhatsApp. 5 options under 150 characters, plain language.

slides.heading: Then iterate
slides.body: The first answer is a draft, not the result. Say what is wrong, ask again. Two rounds of feedback beats one perfect prompt.

slides.heading: SAVE THE FORMULA
slides.body: Week one done. Follow for week two: 7 things Claude can do that you did not know about.

posts.caption:
Role. Task. Format. That is the entire secret.

Every good AI answer I have ever gotten came from those three parts. Swipe for the formula with real examples you can copy tonight.
